distinct_phase_bundle.warning: The C2 projective-scalar fiber and C3 qutrit-phase fiber are different structures. Equality with the E8-root set requires an equivariant bijection, not just the common count 240.

proved_exceptional_branching: On E8 roots modulo sign, W(E6) orbits are 3 fixed + 27+27+27 + 36.
paper_boundary: BU(1)=CPinfinity and the complex Hopf universal bundle are standard. They do not by themselves force Standard Model factors, torsion, 3+1 Einstein equations, masses, or coupling constants.
